text: Suppose that by the restraint imposed upon the liberty of the press, all censure of the government is forbidden; here is undubledly a choice. The government, in this case, eventually was, the people who might attempt the task of directing the public mind are of two sorts; one, those who would ensure; another, those who would not consume; I choose the latter.
